summary.text: Marcie Grzywacz is the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Democratic incumbent Darrin Camilleri.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a homeschooling mother of three, an ICU registered nurse of 13 years and Mayor Pro Tem of Rockwood.

paragraphs.text: Grzywacz attended Chattanooga State Community College and has worked as a nurse.
She said her campaign focuses on affordability, including lower prices and health care costs, eliminating state property taxes, and building up the skilled trades workforce.
